text:
Yana Wilson and Gina Kim brought their golf journeys full circle this week, teaming up to win the 2026 Dow Championship and claim their first LPGA Tour victories. Long before celebrating at Midland Country Club, both players had already made memories on golf’s greatest stage at Augusta National Golf Club.

Yana Wilson was a two-time Drive, Chip and Putt National Champion, winning the Girls 12-13 division in both 2019 and 2021. She later returned as an Augusta National Women’s Amateur competitor from 2022 through 2024.

Yana Wilson of the Girls 12-13 division reacts as she chips in during the 2021 Drive, Chip and Putt National Finals at Augusta National Golf Club.

Gina Kim finished fourth in the Girls 14-15 division at the 2015 Drive, Chip and Putt National Finals. She went on to compete in the Augusta National Women’s Amateur in 2019 and 2021.

Gina Kim putts in the 14-15 Girls group during the Drive, Chip & Putt Championship at Augusta National on Sunday, April 5, 2015.

Sam Greenwood/Sam Greenwood/Augusta National

Their paths eventually converged on the LPGA Tour, where Wilson and Kim combined for a 17-under-par total to win the Dow Championship by two strokes. At just 19-years-old, Wilson became the youngest champion in tournament history, while the victory marked a long-awaited breakthrough for both players.

Their win is another reminder that junior golf experiences like Drive, Chip and Putt can help lay the foundation for future success. For Wilson and Kim, it is the latest chapter in a journey that began years ago on the road to Augusta National and has now culminated in the LPGA winner’s circle.

MIDLAND, MICHIGAN – JUNE 14: Yana Wilson and Gina Kim of the United States imitate a selfie with the winner’s trophy after winning the Dow Championship 2026 at Midland Country Club on June 14, 2026 in Midland, Michigan. (Photo by Raj Mehta/Getty Images)
